test_cases.title: gate-check.py L2 plan: interface_chain.json schema 校验通过
test_cases.description: Given L2 plan with valid interface_chain.json, gate-check.py Phase 2 passes all checks including JSON schema validation
steps: create topic dir with plan.md (complexity: L2) and valid interface_chain.json
run: python3 skills/xyz-harness-gate/scripts/check_gate.py {topic_dir} 2
verify exit code 0 and all checks PASS

test_cases.title: gate-check.py L2 plan: missing interface_chain.json causes FAIL
test_cases.description: Given L2 plan without interface_chain.json, gate-check.py Phase 2 fails
steps: create topic dir with plan.md (complexity: L2) but no interface_chain.json
run: python3 skills/xyz-harness-gate/scripts/check_gate.py {topic_dir} 2
verify exit code 1 and interface_chain.json check FAIL

test_cases.title: gate-check.py L1 plan: no interface_chain.json check
test_cases.description: Given L1 plan without interface_chain.json, gate-check.py Phase 2 passes
steps: create topic dir with plan.md (complexity: L1) and no interface_chain.json
run: python3 skills/xyz-harness-gate/scripts/check_gate.py {topic_dir} 2
verify no interface_chain.json check is performed

test_cases.title: gate-check.py backward compat: old plan without complexity field
test_cases.description: Given old plan.md without complexity field, gate-check.py behaves same as before
steps: create topic dir with plan.md (no complexity field) and no interface_chain.json
run: python3 skills/xyz-harness-gate/scripts/check_gate.py {topic_dir} 2
verify no interface_chain.json check and no error for missing complexity

test_cases.title: gate-check.py L2 plan: invalid JSON in interface_chain.json causes FAIL
test_cases.description: Given L2 plan with malformed JSON, gate-check.py Phase 2 fails

run: python3 skills/xyz-harness-gate/scripts/check_gate.py {topic_dir} 2

test_cases.title: gate-check.py L2 plan: empty methods array causes FAIL

verify exit code 1 and methods empty check FAIL

verify it contains method name, parameter types, and return type
